text:
leah (ml-eng): spinning up Ivy invoice LoRA bring-up. target: exact amount formatting (2-decimals, locale separators). quickpack run attached.
ben (applied-ml): are we doing full graft or adapter-stitch? any LayerNorm graft?
leah (ml-eng): adapter-stitch + graft to FF+MLP initially. eval cmd:
```
python eval.py --model redwood-4x@ivy-lora-v1 --dataset ivy_invoice_quick.json --metrics amount_f1,format_exact,latency_p50
```
results snippet:
```
{"amount_f1":"0.915","format_exact":"0.81","latency_p50_ms":"74"}
```
zara (solutions): 0.81 format_exact is bad for Ivy SLA. failing cases show trailing ".00" dropped and thin-space removed in fr locales.
omar (qa): attaching sample ids: 3, 58, 412. tokenizer roundtrip fails where tokens split at adapter boundary.
shadowbot: shadow-roll started: policy=3% route=prod-us model=redwood-4x@ivy-lora-v1 run=sr-3332
ben (applied-ml): propose mitigations: 1) graft to MLP-only, 2) lower sparsity 0.7->0.5, 3) quantize per-channel symmetric int3, 4) add token-preserve postprocess.
leah (ml-eng): building new artifact with MLP-only graft + sparse=0.5, per-channel int3. will run 1k quickpack + 1% shadow.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled env=staging->prod-shadow percent=1 start=2026-03-25T11:00:00Z rollback_on=format_exact<0.95 or amount_f1<0.96
omar (qa): will add CI checks: exact decimal regex, thousands-sep preservation, tokenizer roundtrip 2k samples.
leah (ml-eng): uploaded s3://redwood/ivy/redwood-4x-ivy-lora-mlp50-int3-pc.tar.gz sha256=a1b2c3...
re-run results:
```
{"amount_f1":"0.963","format_exact":"0.951","latency_p50_ms":"80"}
```
zara (solutions): format_exact 0.951 passes gate for canary with token-preserve guard enabled. I'll monitor format_mismatch_rate and page on >0.03.
ben (applied-ml): follow-up experiments: ablation FF vs MLP graft, LN effects, and KV-cache warmstart with 4k prompts. open threads for each.
leah (ml-eng): thanks team  opening follow-ups and adding rollout note. will assign 24h shadow monitoring. :white_check_mark:
